name: Tortellini, Chickpea, Spinach & Tomato Soup with Basil

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add chickpeas, broth, and tomatoes to the pot; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2129 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth is boiling, uncover, add tortellini, and stir for a few seconds; return soup to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook until tortellini is just tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions).
instructions.secondary_message: 765 g cheese tortellini, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Wash and dry basil, then pick leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons.
Once the tortellini is tender, add spinach and basil to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Enjoy!
